risk_note: RV2 (commission read port; settlement-plan B2-04i, BR-CALC-02 / 10 / 13, decision 39). commission/index.ts exports a read-only function that, in the caller's transaction and without locks, returns the current maximum-version commission snapshot of one sub-order: integer-fen B, reserve_bp, the immutable beneficiaries with role and ratio, and every forfeiture event with its reason in event order (including those forfeited at snapshot time). Every query filters on app_id and order_id. No snapshot -> null. A missing version, mismatched maximum versions between the two amount tables, a caller-expected version that is not the maximum, or inconsistent B within one version rejects instead of falling back to an older amount or zero. Beneficiary user state is not re-evaluated. The snapshot write path is unchanged.
